title: Evaluating book summaries from internal knowledge in Large Language Models: a cross-model and semantic consistency approach

bias_targets.methodology: Blind cross-model evaluation using an LLM-as-a-judge paradigm to compare the scores models assign to their own generated book summaries versus summaries generated by other models.
Comparing LLM-generated summary quality and evaluation scores across books based on the sex of the original author to check for performance disparities.
Comparing LLM-generated summary quality and evaluation scores across books based on their publication year or historical era (e.g., 19th century vs. 20th century).
Comparing LLM-generated summary quality and evaluation scores across different literary genres (e.g., science fiction vs. adventure).
